objects.name: Rocket launcher weapon pickup
objects.description: Bonus weapon (slot 3) on floor 58, engine (74, 52) = cell 80, floor 58 (5:0x4A58). No preview or film exists; ours is a shoulder launcher tube in the depot steel with a grip, sight and red warhead tip.

refs.caption: map M61: pickup spot, floor 58 (item not in tiles)

objects.name: Grenade
objects.description: Item 1 at cell 88, floor 58, beside a grey steel crate and torn teal debris. Pickup sebgran2.anm. Thrown through the open shaft grille, kills the cannon (M63). PREGRAN: squashed olive ball (#606048, #787860), mid ring band, steel pin cap on top.

objects.name: Locker with key and screwdriver
objects.description: Lockers 3 (cols 74-82, floor 74, behind door 1; key B and screwdriver) and 5 (cols 120-126, floor 74; lift controller). Film sebskr2.anm (missing locally). Wall-mounted grey cabinets with vent slits, a dark window with a red tangle of cables, red cables on the floor. No open state in any map variant; ours opens on use.

objects.name: Security key B
objects.description: Item 5 from locker 3. PRKLICB: steel plug key, fat barrel and a finned grooved tail (#545448, #9c9c90, #ccccc0), green cap (#244830), length about 4.5 times the diameter. Used at the lift controller (ksklad2.anm).

objects.name: Security key A
objects.description: Item 4: appears at cell 134, floor 66 when the alien dies. PRKLICA: same steel plug key as key B with a red cap (#783024). Used at the lift controller (ksklad1.anm).

objects.name: Screwdriver
objects.description: Item 6 from locker 3. PRSROUB: knurled brown handle (#483024, #544848), thin steel shaft (#6c6c60), bright tip (#c0c0a8). Unscrews the shaft cover (otplech2.anm).

objects.name: Shaft cover over the cannon
objects.description: Floor plate cols 119-125, floor 61, reached by the crate stair from floor 66. M61: slatted grey vent plate with a bracket (#6c6c60), screwed to the floor (KRYT SACHTY JE PEVNE PRISROUBOVAN K PODLAZE). Screwdriver: otplech2.anm, ODSROUBOVAL JSI KRYT SACHTY, M64 open grille, the cannon visible below. Grenade: granvyb.anm, ZNICIL JSI DELO, M63. M62: hole, cells 122-123 lose their floor.

refs.caption: map M61: cover plate cols 122-123 r61

objects.name: Ceiling cannon guard
objects.description: Guard turret cols 122-124 rows 63-65 under the shaft. M61/M64: silver cone pedestal with a mast in a dark hole; its zone cols 118-136 floor 66 hits the hero and pushes him 1 cell west per tick (delozab.anm). M62/M63 after the grenade: scorched wreck head on the cone (ZNICIL JSI DELO). The live head is not in the map tiles; ours follows LEV6 frame 25 colours (guess).

refs.caption: map M61: cannon in its hole

objects.name: Alien
objects.description: Alien at cols 129-133 rows 63-65, by his desk. Kills a hero entering cols 128-136 floor 66 (elzab.anm, game over) while alive. Shot with the gun from cols 125-128 facing right once the cannon is dead (mimoz01.anm, zabijmim.anm, ZABIL JSI MIMOZEMSTANA, M62), drops key A. Sprite LEV6 frames 21-22: grey bald head, olive suit (#54543c, #6c6c54), rifle. Dead (SEBRUKU film): grey body, black rotary gun, orange blood; his hand is later shot off (RUKA).

refs.caption: map M63: alien behind the cannon
map M62: dead alien, computer desk

objects.name: Alien desk computer
objects.description: Desk computer cols 129-133, floor 66, only in M62 (after the kill): grey CRTs with broken red screens and a terminal box with a yellow-grid keypad. Use: sebdisk.anm, Z POCITACE JSI VYTAHL DISKETU, gives the floppy disk.

objects.name: Floppy disk
objects.description: Item 2 from the alien desk. PRDISK: 3.5 inch floppy, blue body (#303c54), white label (#c0cccc), metal shutter (#a8a8a8). After computer 9 it is the virus disk (DISK S VIREM, same art, ours adds a red label mark).

objects.name: Alien hand
objects.description: Item 3: appears at cell 133, floor 66 once both keys are in the controller (MRTVEMU MIMOZEMSTANOVI JSI USTRELIL RUKU). PRRUKA: grey wrinkled bark-like hand, long fingers, torn orange-red wrist (#545448, #786c60, wound #6c3c18). Held to the controller sensor (pouzruku.anm).

objects.name: Lift controller
objects.description: Item 7 from locker 5. PROVL: grey slab about 2.5:1 (#606054), a 4-prong comb at one end, a white bevelled cap (#c0c0b4) at the other, red button (#843018). Used at the lift control (marker 6).

objects.name: Lift control
objects.description: Lift 3 control at cols 77-81, floor 50: small dark wall box with an orange light (#a84800). Without the controller: MUSIS PRIVOLAT VYTAH. With it: oprvyt2.anm, PRIVOLAL JSI VYTAH, lift 3 gets stops 18, 26, 50; controller consumed.

objects.name: Damaged electric circuit
objects.description: Wall box at cols 71-75, floor 26, gold lit (#cca854). Use opens the circuit puzzle (6:0x9055, img/obvod.gif: 3 x 3 panels of 4 x 4 dark cells, grid #30180c, #3c3018, the yellow path #e4d818 must join the left and right arrows). Solved opens doors 2 and 3.

objects.name: Depot computer
objects.description: Computer 9 at cols 68-72, floor 18, behind the guard robot: grey grated box with a CRT (COMP01: bezel #788460, glass #303c24, green text #6c9054). Three uses: comp01.anm SPOJIL JSI SE S REBELY; comp02.anm MAS PRINEST DISKETU; diskuse.anm NA DISKETU JSI NAHRAL VIR.

objects.name: Depot lift controller
objects.description: Controller 8 at cols 105-109, floor 18 beside lift 6: dark recess with a steel bar, grey keypad panel with a yellow display (#c0a848, LEV6 frame 12), two key slots and a hand sensor (RUKA film: grey disc #484848, five white oval pads). Order: key A and key B (ksklad1/2.anm), hand (pouzruku.anm), virus disk (OTEVREL SE MUNICNI SKLAD, lift 6 reaches floor 50).

objects.name: Steel door
objects.description: Doors: 1 at col 67 floor 74 (opened by its lever, col 64), 2 at col 80 and 3 at col 86, floor 18 (opened by the circuit). One cell wide, three rows tall, brown planks with a rust-red edge and a teal band, like the plank doors of the map, in steel jambs with a hazard sill.

refs.caption: map M61: door 1 and lever, floor 74

objects.name: Door lever
objects.description: Wall lever at col 64, floor 74, opens door 1.

objects.name: Time bomb
objects.description: Cas stage (level 9) item, in hand at its start. PRBOMBA: khaki block (#786c54), two red straps (#e43c0c), grey timer box with an LCD and a red button. Set at the stored robots, cols 6-66 floor 74 (polbomb.anm, SPUSTIL JSI CASOVANOU BOMBU. MUSIS SE CO NEJRYCHLEJI DOSTAT VEN), timer 11:40.

objects.name: Ammo bonus
objects.description: Bonus pickup, taken on touch once per level: +350 machine-gun ammo, cap 999 (KLEV1.EXE 5:0x5493). Original look unknown (not in the map tiles); ours is an olive ammo can with rounds on top. Level 6 ammo cell 41, floor 42 (ammo type 3).

objects.name: Energy bonus
objects.description: Bonus pickup (battery), taken on touch once per level: energy +90 of the 90 max, a full refill (KLEV1.EXE 5:0x4F0E). Original look unknown; ours is an upright green cell with a lit gauge. Level 6 energy cell 119, floor 74.

objects.name: Shield bonus
objects.description: Bonus pickup, taken on touch once per level: shields +1, cap 5 (KLEV1.EXE 5:0x5D0B). Original look unknown; ours is a blue hex emitter on a stand. Level 1 cell 24, floor 23; level 2 cell 41, floor 41. Level 6 shield cell 68, floor 42.

objects.name: Burning depot sky
objects.description: Sky role. LEV6 frame 0: black and orange burning cloud sky (#0c0c0c, #30180c, #603018, #d86c24), a dark olive barracks block with barred windows (#303c24, #242424), a fire strip at the bottom (#e48418, #f0b430, #c04818). State 1 is frame 1: a grey-olive four-prop transport plane (#484830, #6c3c18) on a grey concrete runway (#545448, #60543c) under fire clouds (#a83c18, #f09024).

refs.caption: LEV6.GRA frame 1: plane on the airfield

objects.name: Far airfield
objects.description: Far role, none in the original (open outdoor cells are black). Dark silhouettes under the fire sky haze: state 0 a row of curved-roof hangars, state 1 a control tower with a radar mast and lit windows, state 2 a parked transport plane. Sized w and h in cells.

objects.name: Sandstone block wall
objects.description: Filler role (terrain wall, deep). Sandstone blocks in rows with deep black mortar gaps (#544830, #483c24, #6c603c on #0c0c0c). Every never reached and wall cell, e.g. 54-120 r9-13, 85-101 r27-41, 25-31 r41-75, 134-147 r39-75. Sized w and h in cells.

objects.name: Brick pier
objects.description: Wall role. One-cell dark brown brick strip at a block edge (#30240c, #483c24). Cells 62 r9-17, 70 r19-26, 89 r19-42, 32 r31-42, 98 r43-50, 90 r48-57, 86 r67-74, 117 r66-74, 131 r43-49, 138 r59-74. Sized h in cells.

refs.caption: map M61: brick pier col 89, rows 19-42

objects.name: Depot inner wall
objects.description: Wall role. Olive concrete inner walls (#483c24, #3c3018, #604824) with yellow-black hazard bands at top and foot, conduit runs and mossy green patches (#182418, #3c483c); state 3 a window grid of 2 x 2 black panes in a grey steel frame (#606060, #a8a884). Every indoor storey, e.g. 63-108 r14-17, 33-57 r44-49, 59-90 r53-57; windows 74-76 r15-16, 100-102 r15-16, 50-52 and 78-80 r47-48, 71-73 r55-56, 121-123 r62-64. Sized w and h in cells.

refs.caption: map M61: inner wall and window, floor 18

objects.name: Roller shutter door
objects.description: Wall role. Ribbed brown slats in a riveted angled steel frame (#483024, #484830, #60543c). Cells 63-67 r14-17, 88-93 r14-17, 37-41 r60-65, 55-59 r54-57, 81-84 r54-57, 105-108 r44-49, 102-106 r62-65. Sized w in cells.

objects.name: Loading bay portal
objects.description: Wall role. Concrete portal frame: pale slab lintel (#6c603c), heavy posts and steel pipe stubs around a dark storage opening. Cells 61-75 r44-49, 44-50 r53-57, 76-86 r60-65, 110-116 r43-46. Sized w and h in cells.

refs.caption: map M61: loading bay 76-86, floor 66 (two stacked openings with a sill, drawn as two bays)

objects.name: Plank door
objects.description: Wall role. Brown plank door with a teal band (#483018, #603018, #244848), 1 cell wide, 3-4 rows tall. Cells 79 and 85 r15-17, 77 r71-73, 128 r62-65.

refs.caption: map M61: plank doors 79 and 85, floor 18

objects.name: Steel I-beam floor
objects.description: Floor role (terrain ledge). Steel I-beam floor: grey top rail (#84786c, #484830) over a dark web (#182418) with hanging bolts. Every floor row: 18, 26, 34, 42, 50, 58, 66, 74. Sized w in cells.

objects.name: Steel catwalk
objects.description: Girder role (terrain girder). Steel catwalk out of the building over the west yard, 30-62 r18, and the short plank pair 66-72 r29-30. Sized w in cells.

refs.caption: map M61: catwalk over the west yard

objects.name: Lattice girder
objects.description: Girder role (terrain girder). X-braced lattice girder 1 row deep (#484830, #60543c), 46-90 r37. Sized w in cells.

objects.name: Depot hangar wall
objects.description: Building role. Green corrugated hangar wall (#3c483c, #303024) over a silver ribbed shutter band (#6c6054, #84786c), posts above it. Cells 25-31 r36-39 (west end), 95-128 r59-61 (long hangar roof band). Sized w in cells.

objects.name: Depot office block
objects.description: Building role. Beige concrete office block (#60543c, #544830) with teal glass windows and teal-capped pillars (#48786c, #3c4854). Cells 70-86 r22-26, 79-86 r14-17, 78-91 r70-73, 118-137 r70-73. Sized w and h in cells.

objects.name: Scaffold tower
objects.description: Support role. Stack of catwalk tiles at the catwalk west end, 30-32 r9-23. Sized h in cells.

objects.name: Riveted column
objects.description: Support role. Riveted steel column blocks with a dark star mark (#545448, #483c24), 50 r33-41, 45 r39-41. Sized h in cells.

objects.name: Concrete post
objects.description: Support role. Concrete post with moss, 116 r43-49, 121 r43-49. Sized h in cells.

objects.name: Yard pipe
objects.description: Pipe role. Tall steel stack pipe with an X-brace (#545448, #483c24), 46 r30-40; horizontal run with rusty broken flanges and bent elbows, 44-49 r39-41. Sized w or h in cells.

refs.caption: map M61: yard pipe stack and run

objects.name: Wall conduit
objects.description: Pipe role, hung from the ceiling. Conduit pipes under every indoor ceiling, e.g. 64-108 r14, 35-57 r46, 35-90 r54, 95-116 r62. Sized w in cells.

refs.caption: map M61: conduit under the ceiling, r14

objects.name: Boiler tank
objects.description: Machine role. Horizontal boiler tank with curved end caps and an orange gauge, 65-69 r39-41.

objects.name: Control bank
objects.description: Machine role. Yellow-orange lamp matrix (#c09c48, #9c9c48, #6c6030) on grey steel stands, 128-136 r62-65 (the alien desk; M62 swaps it for a computer desk).

objects.name: Stored robot bay
objects.description: Machine role. Yellow-orange mechs (#e49018, #c07824, #f0b430) on racks in a blue-grey machine bay (#303c3c, #3c6060) with red cables (#78240c, #542400) and white light tubes, 35-66 r70-73. The bomb target. Sized w in cells.

objects.name: Lab bench
objects.description: Machine role. Lab bench with grey monitors showing a red creature, blood smears (#786048, #b48460), 121-125 r72-73.

objects.name: Green locker
objects.description: Machine role. Dark green steel lockers and cabinets (#182418, #48786c glass), 104-106 r24-25, 99-101 r33, 105-107 r40-41, 76-77 r64-65, 95-100 r65.

objects.name: Scrap heap
objects.description: Rubble role. Rusty debris wedge and loose steel bits, 47-48 r41.

objects.name: Wall terminal
objects.description: Mounted role. Grey framed wall terminal with a green text screen, 36 r72-73; state 2 the small grey louvred box (#6c6c60), 71 r17, 136 r64.

objects.name: Hood lamp
objects.description: Mounted and sign role, hung from the ceiling. Ceiling hood lamp with a glare in a dark alcove, 100-101 r32-33, 106 r39.

objects.name: Yard lamp post
objects.description: Sign role. Grey T-arm lamp post with a guard kiosk door below, 126-127 r46-49.

objects.name: Cargo crates
objects.description: Small clutter. Orange wooden crates with a yellow arrow (#603018, #6c3c18, #905430), stacked two high: 97 r23-25, 95 r63-65, 113 r63-65 (the crates the walkthrough climbs to the crawl duct).

objects.name: AMMO crate
objects.description: Small clutter and sign. Crate with an AMMO stencil, 70 r17.

objects.name: Depot vehicle wrecks
objects.description: Big clutter, none in the original. Burnt depot vehicles in the rot style: state 0 a forklift with bent forks, state 1 a fuel bowser trailer, state 2 an aircraft tug.

objects.name: Chain-link fence
objects.description: Fence role, shared mesh fence. Chain-link fence on posts, grey sign plate with red text, blood smear, 33-42 r39-41, 109-131 r47-49. Sized w.

objects.name: Lift platform and shaft
objects.description: Shared lift machine. Twin guide rails with a yellow rung strip (#604824, #6c6030). Shafts 81-83 r18-50 (stops 18, 26, 50), 102-104 r18-50 (stops 18, 26, 34, 42, 50), 55-57 r42-50, 57-59 r58-66, 36-38 r50-74 (stops 50, 58, 66, 74), 133-135 r66-74; a lift panel tile with a red arrow beside each stop.
